snippet.title: Kya Allah Shakal Aur Daulat Dekhta Hai? | Sahih Muslim 2564 #shorts
snippet.description:
Kya Allah aap ki shakal aur daulat ko dekhta hai? Jawab sun kar dil hil jaayega!

Hazrat Abu Huraira (Radi Allahu Anhu) se riwayat hai ke Hamare Nabi Muhammad-e-Mustafa (Sallallahu Ta'ala Alaihi Wa Aalihi Wasallam) ne farmaya:
«إِنَّ اللَّهَ لاَ يَنْظُرُ إِلَى صُوَرِكُمْ وَأَمْوَالِكُمْ وَلَكِنْ يَنْظُرُ إِلَى قُلُوبِكُمْ وَأَعْمَالِكُمْ»
"Beshak Allah tumhari sooraton aur tumhare maalon ko nahin dekhta, balke tumhare dilon aur tumhare aamaal ko dekhta hai."

Reference
• Sahih Muslim 2564c: https://sunnah.com/muslim:2564c

Mehnge kapde nahin, badi gaadi nahin... saaf dil aur achhe aamaal! Aaj ek achha kaam khamoshi se karein, jo sirf Allah dekhe. Comment mein likhein: Ya Allah, hamare dil saaf kar de! Yeh video aage bhejein, yeh bhi ek aur sadqah hai. One more sadqah 🤍
